name: Spotify play by name
description: Play a song, artist, album, playlist (yours first) or the latest podcast episode on Spotify by name, through the Spotify Web API. Needs a one-time setup: run.py --setup <client id>, then run.py --login.
triggers: (?:play|put on|queue up|start playing|listen to|i want to (?:hear|listen to)|let me hear|can i hear) (?!(?:it|that|this|them|something|anything|music|some music|the music|my music|spotify|on spotify)$)(?!.*\b(?:youtube|netflix|videos?|movies?|twitch|hulu|disney|prime video|browser|chrome|edge)\b){q}
